pretreatments.description: Oven drying of açai seeds at 105 °C for 8 hours followed by mechanical grinding (1 mm sieve) and storage at -18 °C.

Subcritical water pretreatment using water at 200 °C and 15 MPa for a residence time of 20 minutes at a water flow rate of 20 mL min⁻¹ with a solvent-to-biomass mass ratio of 80 g water per g of açai seed, resulting in hydrolysis of sugars and release of organic acids.

Integration reactor process where the hydrolysate from subcritical water pretreatment was used as the substrate for anaerobic digestion, with the reactor configuration showing a ratio of 70% hydrolyzed material and 30% mesophilic sludge.

Anaerobic digestion process carried out in a stirred-tank reactor at mesophilic conditions (35 °C) with a hydraulic retention time of 35 days, maintaining pH between 7 and 8 using 6N NaOH additions as needed.
Biogas collection and measurement via gas sampling bags coupled with bioreactors, calculating cumulative volume and yield based on total volatile solids added.
Biogas composition analysis (CH4, H2, CO2) using gas chromatography (GC) equipped with a thermal conductivity detector (TCD) and a micro-packed column (6m length, 3 mm ID) with N2 as carrier gas.

Analytical determination of physicochemical parameters including density, pH, total solids, moisture, total nitrogen, chemical oxygen demand, protein, and total extractives using specific laboratory equipment and protocols (APHA, AOAC, NREL).
